title: My place
grammar: There is / There are + How many…? + preposições (in, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between, near)
today: Hoje você vai aprender a descrever a sua casa: o que tem, quantos tem e onde cada coisa está.
canDo: Dizer o que tem num lugar: There is a couch. / There are two bedrooms.
Perguntar Is there…? e How many… are there?
Dizer onde as coisas estão: in, on, under, next to, behind, between
Falar dos cômodos e móveis da casa

video.context: A família da Peppa está no supermercado e a lista de compras está quase no fim. Falta só um item.
video.predict: Qual você acha que é a última coisa da lista? E o George vai escolher o quê?

questions.q: What is the last thing on the list?

options: Apples, oranges, bananas and a melon

vocab: deixa pra lá / não tem problema

lines.text: Jenny is the new neighbor in apartment 12. On Saturday at 4, Tony is in her living room.
Nice apartment! How many bedrooms are there?
There are two bedrooms and one kitchen.
Is there a TV in the living room?
No, there isn't. **Well**, there's a big couch.
Tony is on the couch. Now he's in the bedroom.
Jenny! There's a dog under your bed!
A dog? I don't have a dog!
**Actually**, it's Max, Carlos's dog. He has Jenny's red shoe.
**So**... there are two neighbors in apartment 12!

options: There's a dog under Jenny's bed.

questions.q: Is there a TV in the living room?

chunks.tip: Os cômodos da casa! Bedroom é bed (cama) + room (cômodo): o cômodo da cama. E living room é a sala, onde a gente vive o dia. Kitchen tem som de "kítchen".
examples: On Saturday at 4, Tony is in her living room.
There are two bedrooms and one kitchen.

practice.en: Carlos is in the living room.
alt: Carlos is in his living room.

practice.pt: Tem três quartos e uma cozinha.
practice.en: There are three bedrooms and one kitchen.
alt: There are three bedrooms and a kitchen.
Now she is in the kitchen.

chunks.tip: Os móveis principais. Americano fala muito mais couch do que sofa pro sofá. E TV se fala "ti-vi".
examples: There's a dog under your bed!
Is there a TV in the living room?

practice.pt: Tem um cachorro embaixo da cama do Tony!
practice.en: There's a dog under Tony's bed!
alt: There is a dog under Tony's bed!

practice.en: Is there a TV in the bedroom?

chunks.tip: Em português a gente fala "tem". Em inglês, pra dizer que uma coisa existe num lugar, é THERE IS (uma) e THERE ARE (várias). Nunca "have" aqui! There's = there is.
examples: There are two bedrooms and one kitchen.
So... there are two neighbors in apartment 12!

alt: There is a dog in apartment 12.

practice.en: There are two neighbors in apartment 15.

chunks.chunk: Is there…? / How many… are there?
chunks.tip: Pra perguntar, é só inverter: there is → IS THERE? E pra contar: HOW MANY + coisa no plural + ARE THERE? A resposta curta: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
examples: Is there a TV in the living room?

practice.en: Is there a TV in the kitchen?

chunks.pt: embaixo de / em cima de / dentro de, em
chunks.tip: Onde está? UNDER = embaixo. ON = em cima, encostado (on the couch). IN = dentro (in the bedroom, in apartment 12). Na tabela tem mais: next to, behind, in front of, between, near.
examples: There's a dog under your bed!

practice.pt: Tem um gato embaixo da cama!
practice.en: There's a cat under the bed!
alt: There is a cat under the bed!

practice.pt: Agora a Jenny está no quarto.
practice.en: Now Jenny is in the bedroom.

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: There aren't three bedrooms. There are two.
Não tem três quartos. Tem dois.
Is there a TV? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
dentro / em cima / embaixo / ao lado de
behind / in front of / between / near
atrás de / na frente de / entre / perto de
grammar.tip: Uma coisa = THERE IS (there's). Várias = THERE ARE. Pergunta é só inverter: Is there…? Are there…? E "tem" de existir NUNCA é "have": a gente fala "There's a dog under the bed", não "Have a dog". Falou, validou! 🚀

gossips.title: Where Is Sam's Phone?

lines.text: It's Monday at 7:15. Sam, 15, has a big problem.
Mom! Where is my phone?
Is it on the couch?
No. There's a pizza on the couch.
A pizza? Sam! Is it under your bed?
No. There are three socks and a banana under my bed.
A banana?! Is it behind the TV?
No, it isn't! And my bus is at 7:30!
Lily, 8, is next to Sam.
Sam... your phone is in your hand.
**Well**, Sam is 15. **You know**... it's Monday.

options: Where is the phone? Sam doesn't know.
Lily says: the phone is in Sam's hand.
Rosa has a new phone for Sam.

gossips.title: Tony's Very Big Apartment

lines.text: Tony lives in apartment 101.
Jenny, my apartment is very big! There are five bedrooms and two kitchens!
Five bedrooms? In apartment 101? Wow!
On Friday at 8, Jenny and Carlos are in Tony's apartment.
Tony, how many bedrooms are there?
**Well**... there's one bedroom. But there's a very big bed in it!
And the two kitchens?
**Actually**, there's one kitchen. It's between the couch and the bed.
Tony... your kitchen is in your bedroom!
Yes! Two rooms in one. Very big!

options: Tony says: two rooms in one!

questions.q: How many bedrooms are there in apartment 101?

options: Between the couch and the bed

realtimes.title: O Max está em todo lugar
realtimes.pt: A Rosa mora no apartamento 1. Tem três quartos e uma cozinha grande. Na sala tem um sofá azul e uma TV. Na segunda, o Max está embaixo do sofá da Rosa. Na quarta, ele está atrás da TV do Tony. Quantos cachorros tem no prédio? Só um: o Max! Mas o Max está em todos os apartamentos.

On Wednesday, he's behind Tony's TV. How many dogs are there in the building? Only one: Max! But Max is in all the apartments.

realtimes.pt: O meu quarto não é muito grande. Tem uma cama e duas cadeiras. Embaixo da cama tem quatro sapatos e um gato. Tem TV no meu quarto? Não, não tem. Mas tem um violão ao lado da cama. No sábado, às 9 da noite, eu toco violão. O meu vizinho não está feliz!
